g.text: Ion-exchange service and regeneration are distinct operating steps

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Synthetic breakthrough and generic exchange cycle. Service transfers selected ions to resin and releases counterions; regeneration restores exchange sites
while producing concentrated waste. Regenerant and rinse flows occur in separate steps, not concurrently with this service sketch. Resin selectivity,
competing ions, capacity, and fouling determine performance.
